I visited North Durham Animal Hospital for the first time after I was referred when my chihuahua, Zoe, had a freak accident in our home.
To say that I was stressed and upset when I approached their establishment was an understatement!
I appreciated the professionalism and support that was provided to me during this challenging encounter. Several treatment options were explained to me in detail, and a breakdown of the costs for these options were easy to comprehend.
I feel that the five stars that I am posting reflect the exceptional care and treatment provided, and I wholeheartedly recommend their services if ever needed.
Very professional, knowledgeable, and caring staff. Also being open on Saturday is a real godsend. Thank you so much for taking care of my little dog!
Thank you for your kind feedback. We are happy we get to care for your fur baby!

The absolute best veterinary care we’ve ever experienced!

We want to give a huge and heartfelt thank you to Dr. Ozak and the entire team at North Durham Animal Hospital for taking such wonderful care of our pets over the past few years. Every visit has been met with kindness, professionalism, patience, and genuine compassion.

Today was our last visit for our annual checkup as Heights residents, and it was honestly bittersweet. We are so grateful for all the care, attention, and love Dr. Ozak and his staff have given us throughout the years. They have always made us feel heard, comfortable, and confident that our pets were in the very best hands.

Dr. Ozak is truly an exceptional veterinarian — knowledgeable, thorough, compassionate, and clearly someone who genuinely cares about the animals he treats and the families who love them. His staff has been just as amazing, and we could not have asked for a better veterinary team.

We are so sad to say goodbye and will genuinely miss everyone at North Durham Animal Hospital. ❤️ Thank you for everything you have done for us and our fur babies over the years. We will always be grateful for the wonderful care and memories.

And even though we are moving away, if we are ever back in town, you can be sure we will schedule our annual checkups with North Durham Animal Hospital. That’s how much we trust and appreciate this team. We would happily make the trip because you are truly worth it!

Thank you, Dr. Ozak and team, for being absolutely amazing. We appreciate you more than you know! 🐾❤️

I’ve been bringing my fur babies for the last year and have always had a positive experience.

However, my most recent experience was a little scary because my cat had a urinary blockage. If it wasn’t for the Team at North Durham animal Hospital and specifically, Dr. Minor I don’t know if my fur baby would be alive right now. Dr. Minor was quick to assess him and let me know that I needed to go to a pet ER and also did what she could in clinic to provide temporary relief for him Until I was able to find a clinic to perform the procedure on him. For her, I’m enterally grateful.

I’ll never take my fur babies anywhere else, the next day in was in for my puppy ‘s vaccines and everyone was so kind to ask me how my cat was doing. They truly care and will always have my business. I highly recommend.

Second dog down. Staff was so wonderful and helpful as my male is unsocialized and a bit nervous at the vets due to past experience. Pricing is a bit on high end and building is older but we had a great first experience. Follow up needs to be a little better. Never got email on flea medication for dog taking seizure meds or the costs to have him fixed.

Thank you from the bottom of my heart to Dr Deville and the compassionate young tech who assisted on July 13, when I went in for a quality of life assessment for my beloved dog Pepita. At 15 (or 16, I adopted her 12 years ago, so I’m not 100% sure of her age) she has been living with a heart condition for the last 3 years of her life. When I visited about 6 weeks ago, another kind vet at this practice ran tests and prescribed more meds, but I always knew her condition would deteriorate with time and age, as would her quality of life. So it was time to have that talk, and Dr Deville and the vet tech were both so empathetic throughout the conversation about her quality of life and then euthanasia. I know my grief process will evolve, but I’m certain I have been taking Pepita to the right place. She looked so beautiful, cozy, and loved when she passed. Thank you for this important work that you do helping owners and families have these tough conversations and decisions about their pet family members. RIP my sweet Pepita, you were such an excellent companion for 12 years of my life and I’ll love you forever 🌈💗🦴
